answer: A prepaid compute grid can price identity directly: no agent transacts until it presents a receipt for one uniquely serialized GPU-hour, signed by an independent provider whose own bond burns if that serial is ever issued twice. Splitting one agent into a thousand clones now costs a thousand real receipts, keeping fake clusters below the horizon of useful profit. A small ember of verified work unlocks a second unit; the glacier of queued attackers just melts into fees.
